about: Server game-state component created when the server loads modules: the game state at bg3.exe+0x304EC20 (slot 3 of the state table bg3.exe+0x57FE200) creates it on a new entity and copies into it the module list of the ls::ModuleSettings it holds at +0x18 (ModuleShortDesc array at +0x20). An object with a one-slot virtual table (destructor) followed by an Array of 0x78-byte ModuleShortDesc - the element equals SE's ModuleShortDesc (GameDefinitions\Module.h). Never seen alive. Registry total 32 (server row).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x304EF90 (AllocRaw 0x20) writes at +0 the address of the virtual table at bg3.exe+0x54C2BB0 (table of 1 slot, bg3.exe+0x3BC4350).

Creator zeroes +8 and +0x10. Writer bg3.exe+0x304EC20 calls bg3.exe+0x2FA2CF0 with component+8 and state+0x20 - an Array copy (buffer, capacity +8, size +0xC) with stride 0x78 and element copy bg3.exe+0x1001600. Storage destructor bg3.exe+0x6B8230 destroys the pointer stored at +8 as a new[] array of 0x78-byte elements.
Creator writes uint32 0 at +0x18; nothing read here uses it.

The element's last member (+0x70) is taken from SE's ModuleShortDesc, not from code read here.
